title: Step 59-D Home category and brand discovery
description: Implement production Home discovery entry surfaces from the authoritative GET /products data already loaded by Stage 59-C. Build only a presentation projection from validated id/slug/name_fa fields inside ProductCard primary_category and brand objects, deduplicate without inventing ranking, route categories to the existing /category/:slug Step-60 placeholder, and route brands through the existing /search?q= entry using the brand Persian name. Do not call /categories or /brands while their generated OpenAPI response bodies remain untyped; do not invent a Brand page, taxonomy DTO, ranking/recommendation algorithm, listing behavior, filters, pagination, product cards, promotions, or backend/API changes.

acceptance_criteria.description: Home discovery derives category and brand presentation entries only from the Stage-C GET /products ready data; each accepted reference must have non-empty id, slug and name_fa and malformed/unknown objects are ignored fail-closed.
Category entries link to /category/:slug and brand entries use the existing /search?q=<Persian brand name> entry; no new Brand page or uncontracted brand query parameter is invented.
Deduplication preserves first authoritative occurrence without client ranking, recommendation scoring, fake counts, fake inventory, fake discounts or invented taxonomy ordering.

No /categories or /brands API call or parallel authoritative taxonomy DTO is introduced while their generated OpenAPI list response bodies remain untyped; backend/API/OpenAPI/database/dependency files remain unchanged.

Home now owns one production H1 and accessible responsive discovery sections while Step-60 category/search routes remain placeholders; product merchandising, promotions and complete state UX remain reserved for later Step-59 stages.

Root pnpm verify, exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront Browser Quality, deterministic review, active exact-artifact lock, protected merge and exact-SHA postmerge verification pass before Stage 59-E starts.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage 59-D is MEDIUM risk. Direct-main write/raw merge are prohibited. Stage 59-E remains blocked until protected transport and exact-SHA postmerge verification are green.
